glosses: Roman (of, from or relating to the city of Rome, capital of Italy)
Roman (of, from or relating to Rome (ancient empire covering much of the land surrounding the Mediterranean))
of Rome as the seat of power of the popes, heads of the Roman Catholic Church

examples.text: El puente lo construyeron los romanos.
examples.en: The bridge was built by the Romans.

examples.text: Estoy buscando libros acerca de la historia romana.
examples.en: I'm looking for books on Roman history.

examples.text: Cuando en Roma, haz como los romanos.
examples.en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

examples.text: En el siglo VI, los anglosajones adoptaron las letras romanas.
examples.en: In the 6th century, the Anglo-Saxons adopted Roman characters.

examples.text: Los romanos construyeron una flota de trescientos barcos.
examples.en: The Romans built a fleet of three hundred ships.
